title: Beijing seeks tighter grip on AI exports amid US rivalry
hook_before: China is tightening control over AI exports to counter United States pressure.
script:
Two superpowers are locking horns over AI hardware. China is restricting AI exports to counter American pressure.
The Ministry of Commerce added high-performance computing hardware to its export restricted list.
This move targets advanced chips essential for training large language models.
Beijing previously required licenses for specific gallium and germanium exports.
These restrictions directly impact global supply chains for AI development centers.
Will these new rules slow down global AI model training?
